text:
Megan (CSM): quick preflight for Catalyst private deploy this week — checklist: egress, IAM roles, KMS key, audit logs, and a note on renewal timing (trial credits end next Tue). can folks confirm blockers?

Arjun (NetEng): we provisioned the VPC + subnets earlier. security groups currently deny 0.0.0.0/0 egress as requested. we need the customer to confirm which outbound CIDRs to allow for telemetry/backhaul (redwood-control-plane, monitoring endpoints).

Javier (Catalyst): prefer minimal open. we can allow redwood IP ranges + our observability stack (10.20.0.0/16). can you share the IP list?

Arjun (NetEng): sure — redwood-control: 52.23.44.12, 18.204.13.2 (will be a small set). for ops I've pasted the sample SG rule we used:

```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_redwood_egress" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["52.23.44.12/32", "18.204.13.2/32", "10.20.0.0/16"]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id
}
```

Priya (Security): KMS note: Catalyst asked for customer-managed key (good). we need the following on the key policy: allow Redwood service principal (redwood-kms@redwood-inference) to Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, plus admin principals from Catalyst. also confirm if they want automated rotation (recommended).

Javier (Catalyst): yes to customer-managed, rotation every 90 days is fine. send exact IAM statements we should add.

Priya (Security): here's the minimum statement (paste for their infra team):

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-kms"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Derek (Solutions): for audit logs — we recommend sending CloudTrail to an S3 bucket and forwarding to Splunk/Datadog. please confirm bucket naming and if Catalyst wants us to subscribe to feed for quick troubleshooting.

Javier (Catalyst): bucket will be s-catalyst-audit-logs-usw2. we can grant Redwood the s3:GetObject, PutObject permissions for the folder prefix /redwood/*. also happy for Splunk forward.

deploy-bot: infra-check: logging-bucket(s-catalyst-audit-logs-usw2) exists — permissions incomplete (s3:PutObject missing for role arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-ingest).

Arjun (NetEng): action: Catalyst infra team to add s3 PutObject for redwood-ingest role and confirm egress CIDRs.

Priya (Security): action: Catalyst to attach the KMS policy snippet and share the key alias (we'll validate access).

Derek (Solutions): i'll run a 30min enablement walkthrough tomorrow 10am PT — cover routing, failover, and logging. will record.

Javier (Catalyst): ack, 10am PT works. we'll try to get infra changes in by EOD today.

Megan (CSM): thanks. a couple of admin items —
- renewal risk: trial credits end Tue; if we miss go-live by then, finance may pause access which impacts the artifact retention SLA. we should aim for Monday sign-off or credit extension.
- please paste any error messages if the PutObject still fails after policy change; Priya/Arjun will stand by.

Javier (Catalyst): understood — i'll ping once policies applied.

Megan (CSM): TL;DR action items for Catalyst: (1) add s3 PutObject for redwood-ingest role, (2) attach KMS policy and share alias, (3) confirm egress CIDRs. Redwood action items: (A) enablement session 10am PT (Derek), (B) validate KMS/key access (Priya), (C) validate SG rules and do a quick post-change connectivity smoke test (Arjun).

Megan (CSM): tagging follow-up owners: @Arjun, @Priya, @Derek — i'll close the loop after the 10am. :thumbsup:

Arjun (NetEng): will do quick smoke test after they update policies.

Priya (Security): will validate KMS perms and rotation flag.

deploy-bot: infra-check: post-change smoke tests scheduled at 1723510800 by Arjun.

Megan (CSM): great — marking this thread as the canonical preflight. please keep updates in this thread so I can capture feedback for renewal/enablement. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
